title: Junior Maintenance Engineer
description:
Junior Maintenance Engineer – Wolverhampton

Permanent | Site-Based | Maintenance | 40 Hours Per Week

Develop your engineering skills. Improve equipment reliability. Help keep production moving safely.

We are looking for a Junior Maintenance Engineer to join our Perrin & Rowe brand and support the safe operation, routine care and repair of production equipment and site services at Wolverhampton. Working alongside experienced engineers and a named mentor, you will develop your mechanical, electrical and fault-finding capability through structured training and supervised experience.

This role sits within our Maintenance team and plays an important part in improving equipment reliability while developing the next generation of engineering capability.


What You Will Be Responsible For

Planned Maintenance

  • Assist engineers with planned preventive maintenance activities.
  • Complete routine equipment inspections under appropriate supervision.
  • Support lubrication, belt, chain, guard and filter checks.
  • Replace worn mechanical parts when directed by a competent engineer.
  • Help complete maintenance work safely and within planned timescales.

Breakdown and Fault-Finding Support

  • Support engineers responding to production equipment breakdowns.
  • Assist with initial diagnosis and structured fault-finding activities.
  • Carry out directed repair tasks within your level of competence.
  • Support simple electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic checks under supervision.
  • Help return equipment to production after approval from a competent engineer.

Maintenance Records and Resources

  • Complete job cards, checklists and maintenance records accurately.
  • Record identified faults, completed repairs and parts used.
  • Note any follow-up work needed to protect equipment reliability.
  • Keep maintenance tools, spares and workshop resources organised.
  • Report low stock of critical maintenance spares promptly.

Safety and Workplace Standards

  • Follow site safety procedures, permits and safe systems of work.
  • Apply isolation and lock-off processes only when trained and authorised.
  • Never undertake live electrical work.
  • Maintain clean, organised and 5S-compliant working areas.
  • Stop and escalate work when equipment or working conditions are unsafe.

Improvement and Development

  • Contribute practical ideas that could reduce breakdowns.
  • Support small engineering projects, installations and machine moves.
  • Work through the site skills matrix with your named mentor.
  • Complete agreed site training and external development courses.
  • Participate positively in regular progress reviews.

For This Role We Would Need You To Demonstrate

Essential Experience and Skills

  • A genuine interest in developing a career in engineering and maintenance.
  • Good practical and mechanical aptitude.
  • A relevant Level 2 or Level 3 engineering qualification, current studies towards one or equivalent practical experience.
  • GCSEs or equivalent in Maths and English.
  • A willingness to develop mechanical, electrical and fault-finding knowledge.
  • The ability to follow instructions, procedures and safe systems of work.
  • A reliable approach with good timekeeping.
  • A positive attitude to teamwork, feedback and structured learning.

It Would Also Be Beneficial If You Have

  • Previous experience in maintenance, engineering or manufacturing.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical or mechanical principles.
  • An understanding of pneumatic or hydraulic systems.
  • Basic computer skills and confidence completing digital records.

Why Work With Us?

At Fortune Brands Innovations, our people are at the heart of everything we build. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, work-life balance and career growth, because when our people thrive, so do our brands.

Health, Wellbeing & Financial Security

  • Health & Wellbeing Programme, including a Health Cash Plan to help with everyday healthcare costs.
  • Life Assurance & Pension Plan to support you and your loved ones.
  • Annual Incentive Plan bonus structure, so you share in our success.
  • Employee Assistance Programme, offering confidential support when you need it.
  • Eye Care Support for frequent screen users.

Work-Life Balance

  • 33 days holiday, inclusive of Bank Holidays, including summer and Christmas shutdowns.
  • Flexible Working Model, supporting flexibility where appropriate for the role.

Career Development & Recognition

  • Career Development: Build your future here, with opportunities to grow your CNC machining, programming and quality inspection capability.
  • Employee Recognition Programme, celebrating the people who make a difference.
  • Refer a Friend Programme, rewarding you for helping us grow our team.

Lifestyle & Everyday Perks

  • High Street Reward Scheme, with a wide range of discounts and savings.
  • Cycle2Work scheme, restrictions apply.
  • Free parking on site.

Our Hiring Process

  • You’ll be contacted by our Talent team for an initial conversation.
  • You’ll be invited to our site for an engaging 1 or 2-stage interview process.
  • We’ll give you full clarity on what to expect, so you can truly shine.
  • If successful, we’ll confirm your start date and welcome you to your Fortune Brands journey.
  • If you haven’t heard from us within 4 weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful.

Note for Recruitment Agencies

We manage our vacancies internally, preferring direct hires and referrals. When required, we engage agencies from our Preferred Supplier List. Speculative CVs from agencies not on our Preferred Supplier List will not be considered, and no introduction fee will apply.

About Us

Fortune Brands Innovations is a US-based company, listed on the New York Stock Exchange, that owns and develops a dynamic portfolio of brands for homes worldwide. Our specialist kitchen and bathroom division, Fortune Brands Water Innovations, is made up of leading luxury British brands Shaws, Perrin & Rowe and Victoria + Albert, plus Riobel from Canada. We market these together under the House of Rohl name. In addition, Aqualisa completes our portfolio with its market-leading digital showering technology.
